items.title: Sunday Night Football: Ravens come back to beat Falcons in OT, 30-23
items.text: Derrick Henry had 120 yards from scrimmage and a TD in the victory. Michael Penix Jr. had to exit late with a rib injury.

items.title: Dre Greenlaw could be facing another suspension
items.text: NFL will review Sunday's conduct that resulted in an ejection for further discipline.

items.title: Packers LB Zaire Franklin: Luther Burden said he'd make us quit, but he quit Sunday
items.text: The Packers blew leads late in losses to the Bears in both the regular season and playoffs last season, which would have provided Green Bay with plenty of motivation for Sunday's game at Lambeau Field all by itself.

items.title: Sean Payton: Offense was good enough to win, but things we need to improve on
items.text: Broncos head coach Sean Payton's return to calling the team's offensive plays didn't result in a transformation on that side of the ball against the Chargers on Sunday.

items.title: Mike LaFleur on possible QB change after latest loss: "Jacoby [Brissett] was not the problem"
items.text: The Cardinals lost their franchise-record ninth straight home game on Sunday, in blowout fashion to the Lions.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs "for sure" trying to break LaDainian Tomlinson's single-season TD record
items.text: Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs scored a pair of touchdowns in Sunday's 45-24 win over the Cardinals and that pushed him ahead of a Lions legend for the most touchdowns before the age of 25 in NFL history.

items.title: Dan Quinn committed a fireable offense, and ownership knows it

items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: I was thinking too much on late drop
items.text: Wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba has come through for the Seahawks many times over the past couple of seasons, but he wasn't able to do so late in Sunday's 32-29 loss to the 49ers.

items.title: Commanders' OT meltdown puts plenty of players in an awkward spot
items.text: The aftermath of Sunday's overtime disaster from the Commanders will resonate for the remainder of the 2026 season, and perhaps beyond.

items.title: Three-sack game makes David Bailey favorite for defensive rookie of the year
items.text: The Jets made linebacker David Bailey the second overall pick in the draft because they believed he could make game-changing plays off the edge in their defense, but his first four games led to some grumbling about his lack of impact.

items.title: Jaguars are bringing a healthy long snapper to London for Week 6
items.text: Thanks in part to a helping hand from Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni, the Jaguars survived the loss of long snapper Ross Matiscik in Sunday's win but they aren't going to risk having to scramble again in Week 6.

items.title: Fred Warner on Mike Evans: Unreal how he shows up every week and dominates
items.text: Wide receiver Mike Evans built a reputation for clutch catches and consistent production over 12 years with the Buccaneers and he didn't leave any of those skills behind when he moved on to the 49ers as a free agent this offseason.

items.title: Robert Saleh: Cam Ward's our starting quarterback
items.text: The Titans drove for a field goal to open Sunday's home game against the Texans, but any hope that was a sign of good things to come came crashing down over the rest of the afternoon.

items.title: Kenneth Walker has more rushing yards in 4 games than the Seahawks have in 5
items.text: The Chiefs had their bye this week, meaning they've only played four games.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: I try to fight for extra yards, it bit me on Sunday
items.text: The Giants didn't win on Sunday, but running back Cam Skattebo still let out "a sigh of relief" when the clock ran out in overtime against the Commanders in Washington.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza: Good to gain some regular season experience
items.text: The first overall pick of the 2026 draft made his regular season debut on Sunday afternoon.

items.title: Big Ten admits ref blew call on Oregon's failed two-point conversion in 17-15 loss to UCLA
items.text: In Saturday's 17-15 loss to UCLA, Oregon was stopped short on a game-tying two-point conversion attempt with 2:16 left.

items.title: Michael Penix: If we got ball first in OT, I could have stayed in
items.text: The final play of Sunday night's game saw Falcons backup quarterback Tua Tagovailoa throw an interception to seal the Ravens' 30-23 overtime win while starter Michael Penix watched from the sideline with a rib injury.

items.title: Marvin Harrison deal was most likely done before Sunday's games started
items.text: On Sunday, the only No. 18 in Arizona was in the stands; receiver Marvin Harrison didn't play — and presumably wasn't even in the building — one day after the mysterious half-report emerged from Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport of ESPNFL that Harrison would be traded to a team to be named later.

items.title: In 5 overtime games, 3 teams have chosen to kick, 2 have chosen to receive

items.title: Two former Cardinals employees sue team, Michael Bidwill for racial discrimination

items.title: Kevin Stefanski on Michael Penix's rib injury: We'll know more as we get imaging
